adaptive_policy.decision: freeze only after new roster pilot and 2 clean 25-worker thermal runs

determinism_gate: serial (first teacher query per root, B=64) and two 25-worker B=64 runs: identical canonical fingerprints on shared queries; the independent B=8 run equals the nested first-8 accounting; interrupt + resume reproduces the uninterrupted B=8 run

label_rule.consistency: no 1->0 flip from B to a larger budget (else BLOCKED: inconsistent scheduling)
label_rule.uncertainty: Wilson 95% interval, reported with every point estimate

negative_diversity_gate.on_fail: confidence-quality gate BLOCKED -> NOT_READY_TO_LAUNCH (no post-hoc roster expansion)

nested_accounting: budget B = the first B scheduled pairs of the 64-pair FULL run (same per-pair seeds and counted work); cross-checked by an independently executed B=8 run

reference.meaning: pilot comparison reference only; NOT exhaustive physical truth; a 64-pair zero stays policy-limited

roster.content: 25 train roots (5 per class, distinct lineage groups), 300 teacher queries + static-ineligible contrasts

runs: v2_ref64_25 (64 pairs FULL, 25 workers, all pilot rows)
v2_adaptive_serial (first teacher query per pilot root, 1 worker)
v2_adaptive_interrupted (ADAPTIVE_FULL 25 workers, SIGKILL after >=5 packed roots, resume)
safety_gate_25_workers: two completed 25-worker ADAPTIVE_FULL runs with boost OFF, zero safety cancels, each independently audited

v2_decision_rule.declared: 2026-11-07, before any v2 pilot teacher call; implemented by mock_v2_gate.py decide (reviewed copy in audit/package/reviewed)
v2_decision_rule.forecast: Q1 CPU and disk from v2_adaptive25_a x 1.5 heterogeneity buffer (+500 MB); wall <= 7 days at the measured 25-worker throughput; free disk >= max(10 GiB, forecast + 1.5 GiB)
v2_decision_rule.negatives: >= 10 label-0 queries from >= 5 lineage groups and >= 3 classes (minimum diversity, not calibration)
v2_decision_rule.nested_identity: adaptive attempts equal the first 8 (or, if all 8 fail, first 32) attempts of the 64 reference, exactly
v2_decision_rule.policy_under_test: ADAPTIVE_FULL: plan the first 8 valid pairs in the frozen order; only if none verifies, continue in the same order to 32; store every distinct verified witness; no archived reuse
v2_decision_rule.recall_vs_ref64: miss = #(ref64=1 and adaptive=0) / #(ref64=1) <= 0.02 overall; <= 0.05 in every block / dest_bin stratum with >= 20 ref64 positives; Wilson 95% reported
v2_decision_rule.reproducibility: two 25-worker adaptive runs: identical per-query fingerprints; serial first-per-root and SIGKILL+resume equal to them
v2_decision_rule.safety: zero safety stops in v2_ref64_25, both adaptive 25-worker runs and the serial run; CPU boost OFF; thresholds 88/80/95 unchanged
v2_decision_rule.verdict: READY_TO_LAUNCH only if every gate passes; else NOT_READY_TO_LAUNCH and no production policy
v2_decision_rule.witnesses: every verified pair's witness id is stored (set equality) and re-certified by the audit

workload_rule.disk_budget: free disk at decision time minus a 1,536 MB reserve (runner cancels below 1,024 MB free)
workload_rule.projection: CPU per query from the 25-worker pilot (screen CPU + per-attempt CPU of the first B pairs, or through the first verified pair for FIRST_SUCCESS), mixed by the quota's block / destination composition; wall = CPU / sustained worker-CPU throughput measured in the 25-worker soak (thermal pauses included); disk = measured packed bytes per query
workload_rule.select: first ladder entry inside both limits; none -> NOT_READY_TO_LAUNCH with the required resources
